patch.value: The model provenance resolver derives the harness session-file path with an incomplete slug encoding, so it silently resolves nothing in any workspace whose path contains an underscore - including this repository

Measured on 2026-08-03 against the installed pm 2026.8.3, which contains PR #874.

pm-ffz0a9 closed on 2026-08-03T00:48 having delivered bounded named provenance resolvers so that the model the primary harness publishes in its own session record becomes expressible. The delivered resolver cannot resolve in the repository that filed the finding, and it fails closed with no signal.

Mechanism, read at HEAD in src/core/shared/author.ts:

- The claude-code descriptor declares provenance_resolvers.model = 'claude_session_file'.
- readClaudeSessionProvenance computes the harness projects directory from the workspace: workspace.replaceAll('\\','/').replaceAll('/','-').
- That substitutes the path separator and nothing else.
- The harness substitutes a wider character class. For cwd <workspace> the harness writes ~/.claude/projects/-home-<user>-GITHUB-RELEASE-pm-cli/<session>.jsonl, with the underscore folded to a hyphen.
- pm computes ~/.claude/projects/-home-<user>-GITHUB_RELEASE-pm-cli/<session>.jsonl, which does not exist.
- fs.openSync throws ENOENT, the surrounding catch returns undefined, and the dimension is written as null.

Direct evidence, 2026-08-03:
- The real session file exists and carries the model: 36 occurrences of "model":"claude-opus-5" in ~/.claude/projects/-home-<user>-GITHUB-RELEASE-pm-cli/20173e7b-41b7-4d51-9073-fa4cc7ab9a1b.jsonl, and 171 in an adjacent session of the same workspace.
- CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID is exported and matches that filename, so the session half of the lookup is correct.
- A fresh pm mutation on this date records agent_provenance {model: null, effort: {value: xhigh, source: environment}}, proving the descriptor is selected and only the model probe fails.
- Recomputing both encodings side by side yields '-home-<user>-GITHUB_RELEASE-pm-cli' from pm and '-home-<user>-GITHUB-RELEASE-pm-cli' from the harness; only the second directory exists on disk.

Why the escape was possible. The unit fixtures for this resolver construct the session directory using the same separator-only transform that the production code uses, so fixture and implementation agree with each other and disagree with the harness. A test that generates the name it is checking cannot detect a wrong name. This is the reason pm-1wiugq measures corpus model coverage at zero percent: the analyzer is correct and the resolver beneath it never fires.

Blast radius. Every history entry written from a workspace whose absolute path contains any character the harness folds is permanently missing its model attribution, and that record is immutable. Fleet attribution analytics per model, the model dimension of any RL or evaluation trajectory, and the entitlement questions that motivated model capture all read this field.

Scope is the path-encoding defect in the resolver. The absence of an instrument that would have caught it has its own owner.

The workspace-to-slug encoding matches the harness encoding for the full character class the harness substitutes, not just the path separator; A test fixture covers a workspace path containing an underscore and asserts a resolved model; Resolution is verified against a real session directory layout, not only against a synthesized fixture whose name is generated by the same function under test; After the fix, a fresh mutation in this repository records a non-null model with source 'probe'
pm 2026.8.3 (contains PR #874), claude-code harness, cwd <workspace>, Linux

Run any pm mutation from a workspace whose absolute path contains an underscore under a claude-code session, then read the newest history entry: agent_provenance.model is null while agent_provenance.effort resolves.

agent_provenance.model records the observed model (claude-opus-5) with source 'probe', because the harness publishes it in its own session record and the descriptor declares the claude_session_file resolver for the model dimension.

agent_provenance.model is null. readClaudeSessionProvenance builds the projects directory name by replacing only '/' with '-', producing '-home-<user>-GITHUB_RELEASE-pm-cli', while the harness itself also replaces '_' and writes '-home-<user>-GITHUB-RELEASE-pm-cli'. The computed path does not exist, the open throws, the catch returns undefined, and the dimension is recorded as null with no diagnostic.
